title: WheelOfChaos
description: A wheel that spins every 2 minuets that could give you a positive event or a negative event
body: WheelOfChaos adds a spinning wheel that triggers a random, high-impact event every 2 minutes, (/wheel start to start) turning normal Minecraft gameplay into constant chaos. Each spin can help you, mess you up, or completely flip your situation with effects like mob ambushes, explosions, or clutch saves, forcing you to react instantly and adapt. Designed for fast-paced, unpredictable gameplay on Fabric for Minecraft 1.21.11.
